text:
Aisha: heads up — after the merge of PR #4823 (attention + fused-op rewrite) the perf CI run for master shows a decode p95 jump of ~28% on the rtx pool. Canary app also reported increased tail latency. Noticed in both small and medium seq traffic.

Tom: saw the alerting graph. p50 is unchanged, p95 and p99 spiking. link: https://dash.re/redwood/perf/master/decode?range=1h :eyes:

ci-bot: perf-ci: triggered perf-bisect job for commits (before=origin/main~5 after=origin/main). Job: https://ci.re/perf/bisect/eps-1715123456. Running baseline vs post-4823.

Luca: I pulled the canary trace. Flame shows extra time in attention_transpose kernel and a new memcpy in fused_matmul_dispatch path. Looks like an extra KV copy happening during shortseq decode warmup.

Priya: quick profile snip I ran locally on small-seq (seq=24, batch=8):
```
% self  cumulative  name
0.12  0.62  attention_transpose
0.09  0.45  fused_matmul_dispatch::memcpy_kv
0.07  0.30  decode_loop::emit_tokens
```
Memcopy shows up right after selector picks fused path.

Marta: is rollback an option? release train says we can hold, but dedicated customers are hitting 5-10% higher cost. Rollout is currently blocked until perf fixes.

Aisha: rollback is heavy; prefer a targeted revert if we can pinpoint kernel-selector change. Who can bisect down to the exact commit inside 4823? @Luca?

Luca: running git-bisect locally on the PR branch now. Early signal points to the kernel-selector heuristic tweak (commit 4823^2) that widened fused_attention_v2 eligibility. When fused_attention_v2 is chosen for certain kv shapes it triggers a zero-fill pad path that memcopies kv into aligned buffers.

Tom: can we temporarily make the selector conservative (revert heuristic) without reverting ABI changes? If yes, we can push a hotfix to main and re-run perf. Please share patch.

Luca: proposing small change — require kv_cache_bytes < 16KB for fused_attention_v2 selection (this avoids shortseq warmup case). Patch:
```diff
- if (seq_len <= 32) return fused_attention_v2;
+ if (seq_len <= 32 && kv_cache_bytes < 16384) return fused_attention_v2;
```
This avoids the memcopy-heavy path for small batches with unexpectedly cached KV shapes.

Priya: that looks safe. Add a unit test for selector with kv_cache_bytes boundary. I'll author the regression test and perf microbenchmark.

Aisha: @Tom can you open a hotfix PR with Luca's change + Priya's test? Mark as perf-hotfix and request expedited CI.

Tom: opened PR #4831 with the selector guard and added CI perf job tag. URL: https://git.re/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4831 :rocket:

ci-bot: queued perf-run:shortseq and perf-run:canary for PR 4831. Expect results ~15 min.

Luca: preliminary local microbench shows p95 back down to baseline after selector guard. Will let CI confirm.

Marta: nice. Once CI confirms we can unblock rollout. Please post final perf graphs.

Aisha: agreed. Once CI green we'll merge and monitor canary for 2 hours before resuming release train. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
